FOR GROWN-UPS

A gentle adventure, together.

Use the spirometer only as your child’s clinician and the device instructions direct. This game does not set breathing targets. Never chase all three balls or a score by breathing harder. Stop if the child feels dizzy or uncomfortable.

Camera setup: stand the device upright in good light. Keep the camera still, with all three chambers visible. Tap each ball at rest from LEFT to RIGHT as shown in the preview. Setup learns their colors, including green, orange, and blue. Their upward movement helps Pip float. Recalibrate if the device or camera moves.

On-device vision: this prototype uses adaptive color tracking and smoothing locally, not a trained AI model. It cannot measure airflow, lung capacity, or treatment progress. Colored objects, reflections, and lighting can confuse it. Physical-device validation is still needed.

No recordings, uploads, or saved health data. Both games save only game scores in this browser. Practice mode is simulated and is separate from camera input.
